ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution exceeding 95% of visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at distal margins and sparse pitting.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid black pigmentation across both lobes; high-contrast white clusters localized at the left and right distal tips; scattered low-density white pixel noise across central regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior angle of 35 degrees and a vertical depth relative to the lobe peaks of approximately 12%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge boundary exhibiting low-amplitude peaks and valleys; higher frequency of serration observed on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lateral lobe boundaries, transitioning to a slight recurve at the extreme distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast white circular pixel clusters localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with sessile barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned diagonal light-gray linear streaks visible on the mid-right lobe, extending approximately 5% of the total lobe width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of barnacle-induced surface disruptions at distal margins; multiple small-scale white circular pits (pockmarks) scattered across the interior of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Irregular notch or indentation on the inner superior margin of the right lobe, located approximately halfway between the median notch and the right distal tip.
